target.heading: All fees for seminars organized by the ANBLS
target.exactSourceText:

will be invoiced annually to a Land Surveyor
Member. The Land Surveyor Member will be
invoiced at the same time as his ANBLS dues, and
the amount will be recorded as a separate item.
Added October 2017

relevantDefinitions.heading: The following definitions apply in this by - law:
relevantDefinitions.text:
1.1.3 The following definitions apply in this by - law:
“ Administrative Committee ” as defined in section 6.1
“ Act ” means An Act to Incorporate the Association of
New Brunswick Land Surveyors
“ Associate members ” means those members as defined
in section 2.1.6.
“ Association ” means the Association of New
Brunswick Land Surveyors;
“ Board ” means the Board of Examiners
“ CBEPS ” means the Canadian Board of Examiners for
Professional Surveyors
“ Complaints Committee ” means that committee
established in section 6.2
“ Discipline Committee ” means that committee
established in section 6.3
“ Member in good standing ” means a land surveyor
member, surveyor - in - training or holder of a certificate
of authorization of the Association who is not in arrears
of any fees or other amount owing to the Association,
and who is not under suspension.
“ Governance Committee ” means that committee
established in section 6.6
“ Honorary members ” means those members as
defined in section 2.1.4
“ Land surveyor members ” means those members as
defined in section 2.1.1
“ Legislative Review Committee ” means that
committee established in section 6.5
“ Life members ” means those members as defined in
section 2.1.3
“ Past president ” means the president elected
immediately prior to the current president
“ Planning Committee ” means that committee
established in section 6.9
“ Practice Review Committee ” means that committee
established in section 6.12. Added 2019
“ Professional Misconduct” Removed from the list January 2020
“ Registrar ” means the secretary of the Association.
“ Retired members ” means those members defined in
section 2.1.7
“ Special meeting ” means a meeting called in
accordance with section 11(5) of the Act.
“ Standards Manual ” means the Association of New
Brunswick Land

next.heading: The ballots shall be counted by the
next.text:
5.1.7 The ballots shall be counted by the
Governance Committee appointed by the Executive
Council. The ballots shall be counted in accordance
with a procedure established by the Executive
Council in order to protect the identity of the voters.
The results shall be announced by the Secretary at the
Annual Meeting according to the following:
(a) The names of the successful candidates.
(b) The total number of ballots cast.
(c) The total number of valid ballots cast.
(d) The total number of spoiled ballots cast.
Revised January 2005
Revised January 2009

of the previously tied candidates and su ch balloting
will continue until a winner is declared.

previous.text:
5.1.8 If the balloting for any office results in two or
more candidates receiving the same number of votes,
the tie vote will be resolved in the following manner.
The Governance Committee shall inform the
Secretary of the tie and a second ballot will be
prepared at the Annual Meeting containing the names
of the previously tied candidates and su ch balloting
will continue until a winner is declared.

next.heading: An Executive Council vacancy shall be
next.text:
5.3.1 An Executive Council vacancy shall be
created when a member of the Executive Council:
(a) dies;
(b) fails to attend three consecutive meetings of
the Executive Council without the prior consent of
the Executive Council, in which case the person is
deemed to have resigned;
(c) submits a letter of resignation which is
accepted and approved by the Executive Council;
(d) ceases to be a member in good standing of the
Association;
(e) a Councillor from a regional zone changes
residence from one zone to another within the
province, in which case the person is deemed to have
resigned effective at the date of the annual meeting
following the change of residence.

next.heading: The duties of the Office of the Secretary shall
next.text:
5.3.3 The duties of the Office of the Secretary shall
include:
(a) Acting as Secretary and recording the
minutes for all meetings of the Association and the
Executive Council, and conducting the
correspondence in accordance with the decisions
taken and policies established at such meetings;
(b) acting as Secretary for the administration
committee and such other committees as the
Executive Council may direct;
(c) acting as a member of the Board of
Examiners;
(d) having custody of the seal of the Association;
and
(e) prior to each annual meeting, submitting to
the Executive Council a list, certified by the
Registrar, of all members in good standing.

document.title: Association of New Brunswick Land Surveyors Bylaws

target.heading: The duties of the Office of the Secretary shall
target.exactSourceText:
5.3.3 The duties of the Office of the Secretary shall
include:
(a) Acting as Secretary and recording the
minutes for all meetings of the Association and the
Executive Council, and conducting the
correspondence in accordance with the decisions
taken and policies established at such meetings;
(b) acting as Secretary for the administration
committee and such other committees as the
Executive Council may direct;
(c) acting as a member of the Board of
Examiners;
(d) having custody of the seal of the Association;
and
(e) prior to each annual meeting, submitting to
the Executive Council a list, certified by the
Registrar, of all members in good standing.

next.heading: The duties of the Office of the Treasurer shall
next.text:
5.3.4 The duties of the Office of the Treasurer shall
include:
(a) collecting all money due to the Association;
(b) certifying all bills and vouchers before
payment. Revised January 2019
(c) keeping proper records, showing the source
and disposition of all income;
(d) submitting at the annual meeting a financial
statement for the most recent fiscal year, duly
certified by the auditors of the Association and such
other reports as may be requested by the Executive
Council; and
(e) other duties and associated tasks that may be
assigned by the Executive Council.
